azion.title: Azion
azion.summary: Everything that is Azion's own: its products, the parts inside them, the platform, its solutions and its services.

product.title: Products
product.summary: One icon per Azion product, named after the product as WebKit and the console name it.

feature.title: Product features
feature.summary: A part that lives inside a product, such as Domains in Workloads or Edge Nodes in Orchestrator. The entry names its product.

platform.title: Platform
platform.summary: The Azion brand, its tools (CLI, API, Ask Azion) and the platform pillars.

solution.title: Solutions
solution.summary: The Azion Solutions, one icon each: the five By Need Solutions and the three By Industry Solutions, named after the Solution's short name.

interface.title: Interface
interface.summary: Generic glyphs for the interface. They name an action, an object or a state, never a product.

arrow.title: Arrows
arrow.summary: Arrows, chevrons, carets, sorting and moving.

action.title: Actions
action.summary: Things a person does: edit, copy, delete, search, share, download, zoom.

status.title: Status
status.summary: Alerts, information, success, help and states such as on, off or loading.

media.title: Media
media.summary: Playback, sound, images, video and recording.

communication.title: Communication
communication.summary: Mail, chat, notifications, calls, feeds and webhooks.

commerce.title: Commerce
commerce.summary: Money, currencies, carts, shops, payment and billing.

device.title: Devices
device.summary: Computers, phones, servers, chips and hardware.

data.title: Data
data.summary: Charts, tables, lists, databases and measurement.

layout.title: Layout
layout.summary: Alignment, grids, columns, windows, menus and controls.

object.title: Objects
object.summary: Everyday objects and symbols: calendar, clock, lock, key, globe, star, flag, tools.

git.title: Git
git.summary: Branches, commits, merges and pull requests.

external.title: External
external.summary: Logos of other companies and projects. Azion does not own them; each is used to name that third party.

framework.title: Frameworks
framework.summary: Web frameworks and site generators an app can be built with.

ai-model.title: AI models
ai-model.summary: AI models and the labs that make them: language, vision, embedding, speech and audio models, open and closed.

ai-tool.title: AI tools
ai-tool.summary: AI agents, coding assistants, agent frameworks and the Model Context Protocol that connects them to Azion.

developer-tool.title: Developer tools
developer-tool.summary: Code hosts, CI/CD, editors, build tools and infrastructure as code.

database.title: Databases
database.summary: Databases, data platforms and the ORMs an app connects to them with.

cms.title: Content management
cms.summary: Headless CMSs and site builders an app reads its content from.

observability.title: Observability and data
observability.summary: Log, metrics, streaming, storage and analytics platforms that Data Stream sends data to.

identity.title: Identity and sign-in
identity.summary: Identity providers for single sign-on, commercial and open source.

security.title: Security services
security.summary: Bot protection, captcha and device identification services that Marketplace integrations call.

online-service.title: Online services
online-service.summary: Social networks, video and community sites, and online APIs such as payments and email.
